title: Project memories: 610 is too many; retire stale working-state snapshots, keep decisions and lessons
outcome: Project memories hold decisions, durable lessons and current facts rather than old queue and window state, nothing of value is lost, and working state stops accumulating there.
acceptance: Each entry proposed for retirement has been read for unique value; any still-valid decision or lesson is kept or moved to a kept entry first, and retirement uses forget, which tombstones and keeps history.
A before-and-after count by family is recorded, along with what was kept and why.
Agents have a clear rule that queue and working state goes on items, not in memories; no test reads instruction files for it.

completion.summary: Project-memory cleanup:610→387 retained heads,214 own tombstones plus10 baseline owner migrations and1 concurrent retained addition. Unique decisions/lessons and citations preserved; full before/after family counts and214-key inventory recorded; working state belongs on items. No source/artifact operations.
